newsitem.title: UK: Chiyoda backs new UK direct insurer.
newsitem.headline: Chiyoda backs new UK direct insurer.

text.p: Chiyoda Fire & Marine Insurance Company (Europe) Ltd on Wednesday launched Hastings Direct in a strategy aimed at gaining a slice of the highly competitive UK motor insurance market. "Hastings Direct is looking to shake up the British insurance market... By starting with a low cost base and low overheads we can give customers genuine value for money whilst offering high quality service," the company said in a statement.

Managing Director Jerry Kendall said Hastings aimed to take business away from the broker market, adding that the company was using state of the art IT and a more detailed risk assessment profile than most insurers.
"We hope to have 65,000 policyholders by the year end, that's about 20 million stg in premium income," Kendall told Reuters in an interview.
Hastings began selling motor insurance policies on January 20, but its official launch was today.
Chiyoda put substantial start-up investment into Hastings, including the purchase of an 80,000 square foot office in Bexhill-on-Sea on the English south coast, but Kendall declined to give figures.
Hastings aimed to spread the start-up costs over three years and, on this basis, to make a small profit at the end of this year, he added.
Chiyoda is one of Japan's ten largest insurers.
